module.name: User Management Core
page.title: Users
page.description: Accounts, roles, and scopes inside the active workspace.
invite.title: Invite a member
invite.subtitle: Email invitation to this workspace
invite.emailHelp: The invitation link is single-use and expires after seven days.
invite.footer: Flowdular sends the invitation through the deployment mail adapter.
invite.error: The invitation could not be sent.
denied.title: Access denied
denied.members: Reading the user directory needs the users.members.read scope.
table.title: Members
table.caption: Workspace users
table.emptyHint: Create the first account for this workspace.
table.emptyFilteredHint: No account in this workspace matches the current filter.
table.note: Roles decide what an account may reach. Owners administer the workspace; every other role carries exactly the scopes it lists.
search.label: Filter members
pagination.label: Member pages
form.initialPasswordHelp: At least {min} characters. The account holder can change it later.
form.ownerOnly: Only an owner can create another owner.
form.footer: The account gets access to the current workspace only.
member.ownerLocked: Only an owner can change another owner.
member.selfLocked: Your own role, scopes, and status change through another owner.
member.scopesDescription: Exact scopes of this membership. Assigning a role replaces them.
member.identityDescription: The email is the sign-in id and cannot change here.
member.roleDescription: A role sets the scopes below; custom roles live on the Roles screen.
member.accessDescription: Turns this membership on or off. It never touches the person's other workspaces or their account.
membership.reasonActive: The member signs in to this workspace normally. Other workspaces are unaffected either way.
membership.reasonDisabled: Sign-in to this workspace is refused and its sessions and API tokens are revoked. Other workspaces keep working.
membership.confirmDescription: Sessions and API tokens for this workspace are revoked at once and sign-in here is refused. Other workspaces stay untouched. Turning access back on restores sign-in, not the revoked tokens.
membership.error: Workspace access could not be changed.
membership.errorSelf: You cannot change your own access to this workspace. Ask another owner.
membership.errorLastOwner: This is the last active owner of the workspace. Give another member the owner role first.
membership.errorOwnerRequired: Only an owner can change another owner's access to this workspace.
membership.errorNotFound: This member is no longer in the workspace. Refresh the list.
member.accountDescription: The global account state an operator owns. Signing out ends every session of this account, in every workspace.
member.accountReadOnly: Blocking or unblocking an account is a deployment operator action and cannot be done here. Use the workspace access switch above to end access to this workspace.
member.temporaryPasswordHelp: At least {min} characters. The member picks a new one at the next sign-in.
member.mfaDescription: Clear the enrolled authenticator when a member loses the device. The member enrols again from account security.
member.removeDescription: Ends the membership with its sessions and tokens; the account stays if it belongs to another workspace.
notice.passwordSet: Temporary password set. The member must change it at sign-in.
notice.mfaReset: Multi-factor authentication cleared. The member must enrol again.
remove.title: Remove this member?
remove.description: {name} loses access to this workspace immediately. Sessions and API tokens for this membership are revoked.
mfaReset.title: Reset multi-factor authentication?
mfaReset.description: {name} loses the enrolled authenticator and every recovery code, and must enrol again before the next sign-in that asks for a second factor.
roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Built-in and custom roles with the exact scopes they grant.
roles.denied: Reading roles needs the auth.roles.read scope.
roles.emptyHint: The built-in roles appear once the workspace is initialised.
roles.note: A role grants a subset of the scopes this workspace can hand out. Assigning it replaces a member's scopes; changing it updates every member that holds it. Roles in use cannot be deleted.
roles.deleteDescription: The role is removed from this workspace. Deletion is refused while a member still holds it.
roleForm.keyHelp: Stable identifier used by assignments and the API; cannot change later.
roleForm.name: Name
roleForm.scopeCount: {selected} of {total} scopes selected. Members holding this role receive exactly these.
roleForm.editNote: Changing scopes updates every member that holds this role.
roleForm.createNote: Built-in owner and member roles cannot be recreated.
error.save: The change could not be saved.
widget.label: Team
widget.note: Accounts with access to the current workspace.
